description: Docker command to launch hermes agent with GITHUB_TOKEN, host gateway, and volume mounts for data and workspace.

steps.description: Container: docker run --rm -it --name hermes for isolated, removable container.
Host gateway: --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway enables container to reach host services.
Token: -e GITHUB_TOKEN with VAULT_PAT environment variable, never inline in prompt.
Volumes: hermes home directory and workspace mounted for persistence.
Image: nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest as the agent implementation.

title: hermes Docker Run Command
